Container.Name: NexCraft-Web
Container.Overview:
NexCraft is a Minecraft-focused server control panel (a fork of MCSManager) with a built-in modpack installer and manager. Search and install modpacks from CurseForge, Modrinth and FTB, build custom servers (Vanilla/Paper/Purpur/Folia/Fabric/Forge/NeoForge/Quilt) or Bedrock, and manage backups, players (RCON), metrics and per-pack Java from one dashboard.
This is the WEB (panel) container. You also need the NexCraft-Daemon container, which actually runs the servers. After both are running, open the web UI, complete first-time setup, and add the daemon node (default 24444) if it isn't auto-detected. Docs: https://dpavlakis.github.io/NexCraft/
Container.Requires: Also install the NexCraft-Daemon container — the panel needs a daemon node to run servers.
